production_policy.scope: interior pages only; cover production is separate
production_policy.print_target: Amazon KDP Premium Color paperback, 6 x 9 inch final trim
production_policy.styles: Zoran scenes use full-color realistic manga; WOA/DOTG scenes use approximately 70% photorealistic and 30% manga; mixed viewscreens preserve both domains.
production_policy.zoran_ears: normal rounded human ears; never pointed or elven; pointed ears belong only to invented demon targets and imagery
production_policy.zoran_writing: all diegetic writing in Zoran scenes uses canonical Zoran script; English Translation text is production reference only
production_policy.chronology: Jeremiel ages from middle-aged to elderly and frail; Josia ages into a veteran commander; preserve identity across states
production_policy.scientific_method: observation, hypothesis, controlled testing, recording, replication, failure, and revision must be visually clear
production_policy.magic: effects remain readable and consistent; blue-violet transmutation pulses are mana luminescence, not mass-to-energy explosions
production_policy.safe_area: faces, lettering space, important hands, props, gauges, samples, and critical action remain inside the generation-safe rectangle
production_policy.art_layer: artwork only; no dialogue, narration, balloons, tails, folios, panel numbers, or production metadata
production_policy.lettering_layer: transparent RGBA placement guide registered exactly to the art layer
production_policy.text_authority: page TXT file controls exact wording and punctuation
production_policy.population_realism: anonymous Zorans vary naturally in age, build, complexion, grooming, posture, and attractiveness while retaining rounded ears and canonical hair colors
